title: Which uses fewer tokens, Unity MCP or Unreal MCP?
author: Square_Reason_6490
selftext: I'm choosing between engines for AI assisted work, and token usage is a big factor for me. If you've used both Unity's MCP server and Unreal's, which one did you feel used fewer tokens? Anything you noticed would help, like how much the AI had to read to understand your scene or how many back and forth steps a typical task took.

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: Why does it actually burn less tokens?

replies.author: MICSaver
replies.body: It is a direct line into Unity better than MCP. It can compile, test, and inspec a game without having to think through every step. So less tokens cause it is sending only the results that require the AI's attention, rather than every intermediate action and output https://youtu.be/FsSu_CHzI2o?is=FvbAEtdH8IHAHCTR

comments.author: joeyb908
comments.body: MCP servers are overrated for things that can run headlessly.

replies.body: Because of what I need I could use both engines, but if one had a token advantage over the other 100$ plan vs $20 I would rather my dollar do as much as possible.
